meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides Quizlet ad units, Google one-tap sign-in and marketing bands; blur or hide page pictures; trim the footer.
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, headless Chrome over CDP with a desktop UA (1440x900) on quizlet.com/ (the marketing home page). Not captured: an iPhone-UA page (machine out of memory/network when retried), study-set, search or class pages (bot protection on set pages), anything signed in.

LIVE counts on Home: marketing-bands desktop home 4; pictures-blur desktop home 11; pictures-hide desktop home 11; footer desktop home 1. The page ships a Google one-tap loader script (`data-testid="google-one-tap-loader"`), which is why the prompt rule exists; the prompt iframe and `.SiteAd` / `.SetPage-adz` are SOURCE only (community filters), so their fixtures (desktop-set-page.html) are hand-written, not captures.

Choice: Page pictures Show/Blur/Hide (blur 10px) on `main img`. Class names beyond SiteFooter, TextCallout-Title and TopNavigationWrapper are hashed and not used; no selector matches on button text.

NOT verified: set pages (term lists, blurred answers behind the login wall), the ad classes, signed-in UI, mobile layout, the Quizlet Plus upsell modal.
